notes.title: 【 Complete v1.0 Version 】 The ending has been updated and the game has been comp
notes.content:
After accidentally releasing the game, it took 3 months to finally release the complete version= w=
This update includes all remaining content, galleries, and 2 endings of the game.
【 Minor modifications 】
1. Slightly increased the difficulty of working at street restaurants
2. Significantly reduced the difficulty of achieving success
3. Added gold coin rewards for gold coins
4. Add some hidden achievements.
Please check the specific content in the game.

notes.title: [Version update on October 12, 2024] Added new store and new animation.
notes.content:
1. Open the Dream Magic Street store - [Cosplay Store] (the protagonist needs to wear a nun's uniform to enter)
2. Added the labor and animation of tentacle spawning.
3. Added tentacle bed H animation
4. Added tentacle bed berserk mode H animation. (The protagonist needs to first take the Seed of Corruption and then interact with the tentacle bed)
5. Add a bed on the left side of the cosplay store, now you can sleep outside of your home.
6. The store has added a new product - fishing rod upgrade. (You can upgrade three times and earn more coins when fishing successfully)
7. Reduced the difficulty of triggering achievements.
8. A teleportation array has been added to the left side of Mengmo Street, allowing the protagonist to quickly return home while in regular server mode.
The above is the content of this update.
[November Full Version Preview]
In November, two more stores on Mengmo Street will be launched with ending triggers.
There are currently two expected outcomes.
Coming soon!

notes.title: [Updated on September 13th] Open Dream Magic Street and Maid Cafe!
notes.content:
1. A new scene has been opened: Mengmo Street (located on the left side of the street), where you need to purchase an invitation letter and a nun's uniform to destroy the fence and enter Mengmo Street.
2. Open a new scene: maid caf é.
3. Add a new job - maid: maid attire is required to perform the job.
4. Add a new H event - Teasing Little Maid: Players need to work and be in a {Fallen} state to trigger it, just take {Fallen Fruit}.
Need to farm first~
5. Add a built-in achievement system. You can earn a large amount of coins by completing achievements.
At present, there are four achievements: {Farming King}, {Fishing King}, {Advanced VIP}, and {Parasitic}. Please explore the triggering method yourself.

notes.title: [August 17, 2024] Add store system, job system, farming system, and dress up!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121033/7ca017a87d08b01060f4c60f4c81cad487aec55c.png
1. Open New Map - Store: You can purchase seeds for farming, Dream Magic Street invitations, and 3 new clothes here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121033/38e68ec7535d618915349b31d72ae3b365eb469d.png
2. Open a new map - small restaurants: You can work daily here and earn coins.
3. Open farming system: You can purchase seeds in the store and plant and harvest crops in your backyard.
4. Open dressing up system: Add 3 new clothes that you can purchase in the store and change at home using the fitting room.

notes.title: [Preview of Subsequent Updates in August]
notes.content:
1. Working system: Players can enter a new map - restaurants, and play working mini games to earn coins inside
2. Store System: Players can enter the new map - Seed Store to purchase plant seeds, clothing, and other small items.
3. Planting System: Players can use seeds purchased from seed stores in the backyard map to plant crops.
There are four types of crops in total, which take a long time to mature and harvest.
(Above is the new content I plan to produce in August)
Coming soon!
